title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness adds Strands harness defaults, built-in tools, and lifecycle hooks
summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness now runs on the open-source Strands harness, bringing a recommended model, task-oriented defaults, automatic prompt caching, proactive context management, and new built-in tools. It also adds lifecycle hooks so you can run deterministic allow or d
reason: AWS blog describes feature updates (defaults, built-in tools, lifecycle hooks) to the proprietary AgentCore harness. No named model release (R1-1), no research artifact (R2-1), not a business event/launch (R3-1), and R5-1 excludes proprietary product features.
